title: Ratio of Ampere forces
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be expressed as the ratio I1/I2.

title: Expression for I3
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be expressed as I3 = (a - g)T0 * I1 / ((T0 - T1)g).

title: Force equilibrium analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply force equilibrium to relate tension, weight, and Ampere force for the I1 case (2T1 + F1 = G).

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: For the breaking case with I3, the solution must apply F_net = ma correctly, resulting in F3 + G = (G/g)*a.

title: Ampere force proportionality
description: Important: The solution must recognize that the Ampere force on the coil is proportional to the current in the long wire (F ∝ I).

title: Weight identification
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly state that the coil's weight is G = 2T0 from the initial no-current condition.

title: Direction of Ampere force
description: Pitfall: The solution must not confuse the direction of the Ampere force; for I1 it is upward (reducing tension), for I2 it is downward (increasing tension).

title: Sign error in acceleration equation
description: Pitfall: The solution must not make a sign error in the net force equation when the threads break, incorrectly writing F3 - G = ma or similar.
